entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-10
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • SqliteDataAdapter' is not defined #37344
  • Stange bug ?? #37343
  • Allow to create a migration and apply it without recompiling #37342
    Backlog
  • Track changes parent-child navigation #37339
  • Script all migrations into single migration per file #37338
  • Entity with shadow property and nullable complex property with discriminator throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException when queried #37337
  • map two nullable complex properties to same column will result in a NullReferenceException #37335

Closed

  • SqlServerSqlNullabilityProcessor incorrectly assumes 2100 parameters as maximum #37336
    10.0.2
  • EF 10: Nullable complex property with PropertyValues.ToObject() creates instance instead of null #37249
    10.0.2
  • dotnet ef migrations script gives me error MSB4057: The target "ResolvePackageAssets" does not exist in the project. #37230
    10.0.2

PullRequests

Merged

  • Fix link to contributing guidelines in PR template #37340
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #37341
  • [release/10.0] Fix parameter counting when type mapping differs. #37333
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.2
  • [release/10.0] Fix parameter limit (because of sp_executesql). #37334
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.2
  • Merge release/9.0 to release/9.0-staging #37331
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #37332
  • [release/10.0] Allow tools to run on projects targeting multiple frameworks #37301
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.2
  • [release/10.0] Fix nullable complex property with PropertyValues.ToObject() and SetValues() creating instance instead of null #37302
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.2
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #37324

Updated

  • Implement MergeOption #36556
    community-contribution
  • Adding support for any collection in ExpressionEqualityComparer #37212 #37250
    community-contribution
  • Cosmos: Update pipeline complex properties #37322
    community-contribution
  • Cosmos db provider: Implement owned type null comparison #37321
    community-contribution
  • Add cosmos db complex properties #37298
    community-contribution
